title: Label arithmetic in T9: affineCaptionParts finds a city's value at index label - 1
claim: affineCaptionParts converts a label to an array index by subtracting 1 (values[l - 1]). This is a stray conversion outside toLabels and toPositions. It gives the right value only on boards whose labels are 1..n.
expected: E-7: 'Two functions, toLabels and toPositions, convert node lists and words; nothing else converts.' On B3 drawn as nodes 2, 3, 4 of B4 (subBoard(B4, [1,2,3]), labels [2,3,4]), the oracle gives kostant_play(sub, 2) ending at (1,1,1) with dynkin_labels (1,0,0). The caption must read sends '1 to city 2' and receives '2 from city 2'.
observed: endPanel gives marked [2] and finalNumbers ['1','0','0'] correctly, but affineCaptionParts returns sends '0 to city 2'.
